artifact_under_test.name: EntityOS
artifact_under_test.origin_note: Downloaded historical workflow artifact and re-executed in the current isolated local sandbox. Its original self-hosted build provenance is not promoted as current sandbox build evidence.

grf.observed_anchor: Canonical direct Clay String argv and Bytes/Buffer ownership/lifetime remain open, while the downstream EntityOS host process adapter already uses direct no-shell argv.
grf.hypothesis: If mixed argv survives the already-built downstream host boundary literally, the highest-information remaining failure surface is upstream canonical Clay String/Bytes/argv/effect typing rather than shell tokenization in the host adapter.
grf.counter_reality: The host adapter may reinterpret empty strings, Unicode, newlines or shell metacharacters even with shell=false, so upstream typing alone would not be sufficient.
grf.falsifier: Send one bounded mixed argv vector containing Unicode+space, empty string, shell-metacharacter payload and embedded newline through the EntityOS capability-gated host path and compare exact argv observed by the child process.

interpretation.promotes: Downstream direct-argv literality for the exact historical artifact re-executed in this sandbox.
interpretation.remaining_shared_blocker: Select and implement the smallest canonical Clay String/argv plus Bytes/Buffer ownership/lifetime and effect-signature surface through checker -> effectful ExecutableTypedIR -> single ClayVM -> controlled Linux process boundary, then rebuild the exact current main as the canonical frozen one-file EntityOS in an actually-started isolated sandbox.
